info.title: Zoho CRM Natural Language Assistant
info.description: This is the read-only Zoho CRM natural-language data tool. Use it for questions about live Zoho CRM data. Pass the user's complete CRM question unchanged in the question field. The backend resolves intent, module, fields, dates, filters, sorting, aggregation, relationships, activity type, and pagination. Do not construct module names, field names, filters, offsets, limits, or COQL.

post.description: Pass the user's complete CRM question unchanged. The backend owns CRM interpretation, field resolution, filtering, sorting, analysis, and pagination. For follow-ups such as next 20, next page, continue, or proceed, send the original question and do not calculate an offset.

question.description: The user's complete original natural-language Zoho CRM request. Pass it unchanged. Do not rewrite, summarize, translate, interpret, or convert it into structured CRM parameters.

conversation_id.description: Optional stable conversation/session identifier used by the backend to preserve conversational state such as pagination. Do not calculate or modify pagination values from this field.

success.description: Whether the backend successfully completed the CRM request.

status.description: Normalized backend status such as success or error.

answer.description: Natural-language answer based only on the actual backend CRM result. Never invent CRM values.

records.description: CRM records returned by the backend.

count.description: Number of records returned in the current response.

module.description: Canonical CRM module resolved by the backend.

module_api_name.description: Exact Zoho CRM API module name used by the backend.

request_type.description: Normalized read-only CRM operation executed by the backend.

request_id.description: Unique backend request identifier used for troubleshooting and tracing.

limit.description: Number of records requested for the current page.

offset.description: Number of matching records skipped before the current page.

returned.description: Actual number of records returned in the current page.

more_records.description: Whether additional matching records are available.
